main_bug_fix_verified.issue: Quotation → deal conversion created deals with status 'active' instead of 'reserved', causing POST /deals/{id}/book to reject them
main_bug_fix_verified.fix: Both quotation conversion and direct reservation now use sales_reserve.reserve(), creating deals with status='reserved'
main_bug_fix_verified.verification: BACKEND-1 test passed - quotation with addons (ADD-TANAH, ADD-HOOK) → converts to reserved deal → booking succeeds (200 OK)
